exercises.name: Push-Up

exercises.tempoCue: 3 seconds down, brief pause at the bottom, drive up in 1.
exercises.setupNote: Shown with the feet on a gym bench — a sturdy chair or the bottom stair is the same thing.

exercises.name: Push-Up to Side Plank
exercises.tempoCue: Press up in 1, rotate over 2, hold the top for a breath.

Alternate sides

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
exercises.tempoCue: Lower over 3 until the elbows touch down, pause, press in 1.
exercises.setupNote: Shown on a gym bench — the floor works fine. Your upper arms stop at the floor, which is a safe depth for the shoulder.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Chest Fly
exercises.tempoCue: Open over 3 with soft elbows, close in 2 — never bounce at the bottom.
exercises.setupNote: Shown on a bench — do it on the floor; the floor stops you at a safe depth.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Extension
exercises.tempoCue: Lower over 3 behind the head, press up in 1 — elbows stay still.

Elbows stay close to your ears
Lower behind head, press up

exercises.name: Triceps Kickback
exercises.tempoCue: Extend in 1, hold straight for 1, return over 2 — the upper arm never moves.
exercises.setupNote: Shown with a knee and hand on a bench — hinge forward from standing instead, free hand on your thigh.

Straighten fully, squeeze, return slow

exercises.name: Lying Triceps Extension
exercises.tempoCue: Lower over 3 towards the forehead, pause, press up in 1.
exercises.setupNote: Shown on a bench — the floor works just as well.

exercises.name: Chair Dips
exercises.tempoCue: Lower over 3, pause at the bottom, press up in 1 — shoulders down.
exercises.setupNote: Shown on two gym benches — one sturdy chair with your feet on the floor is plenty.

exercises.name: Standing Shoulder Press
exercises.tempoCue: Press up in 1, lower over 3 — no leaning back.

Press straight up, biceps by ears
Ribs down — don’t arch the back

exercises.name: Arnold Press
exercises.tempoCue: Rotate and press in 2, reverse it over 3 — one smooth path.
exercises.setupNote: Shown seated on a bench — standing works, and asks more of your core.

instructions: Stand tall, ribs down, palms facing you
Rotate out as you press up
Reverse the spiral on the way down

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.tempoCue: Up in 1, pause at shoulder height, lower over 3 — the lowering is the set.

instructions: Slight bend in the elbows
Raise to shoulder height, no higher
Lead with elbows, pour the jug

exercises.name: Front Raise
exercises.tempoCue: Up in 1, pause at eye level, lower over 3 — no swinging.

instructions: Raise to eye level, arms straight
No swinging — strict and slow
Alternate or together

exercises.name: Bent-Over Row
exercises.tempoCue: Pull in 1, squeeze the shoulder blades for 1, lower over 3.

instructions: Hinge to ~45°, flat back
Row to your hips, not your chest
Squeeze shoulder blades together

exercises.name: One-Arm Row

exercises.name: Reverse Fly
exercises.tempoCue: Open in 1, hold for 1, lower over 3 — elbows stay soft.

exercises.name: Biceps Curl
exercises.tempoCue: Curl in 1, squeeze at the top, lower over 3 — elbows pinned.

instructions: Elbows pinned to your sides
Curl up, squeeze at the top

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.tempoCue: Curl in 1, lower over 3 — no swinging from the shoulders.

instructions: Palms face each other

exercises.name: Concentration Curl

exercises.name: Dumbbell Pullover
exercises.tempoCue: Lower over 3 with the ribs down, pull back over in 2.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Squat

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
